events.description: Memo proposes further options against Bin Ladin, including more direct tracking support to assault his quarters and enlisting Masood.
Taliban forces attack Masood in northern Afghanistan.
CIA memo, 'Further Options Available Against Usama Bin Ladin', lays out options including a more direct assault on his quarters and enlisting Ahmed Shah Masood.
Taliban forces attacked Ahmed Shah Masood in Northern Afghanistan; Masood was thought able to withstand the attacks.

key_claims: The CIA considered further options against Bin Ladin, including a direct assault on his quarters.
The CIA considered enlisting Ahmed Shah Masood as a partner against Bin Ladin.
The memo judged Masood likely to withstand Taliban attacks and remain a force in Afghanistan.
Earlier capture attempts were repeatedly not carried out.
The memo argues that the more options pursued, the greater the chance one will succeed.
